# Agent Hooks

> A framework neutral control contract for AI agents: eight interception points, three verdicts and a conformance kit. A host asks its interceptors for a verdict at each point and enforces it. SDKs for Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go and .NET.

Agent Hooks is a cooperative contract, not a security boundary. 0.1 is the released specification. The draft, wire version `agent-hooks/draft`, changes without notice. The .NET SDK implements the draft only.

## Specification

- [Draft specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/main/spec/draft/AGENT-HOOKS-DRAFT.md): the working text
- [0.1 specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/main/spec/0.1/AGENT-HOOKS-0.1.md): the released text
- [Versioning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/main/VERSIONING.md): how specification and package versions move

## SDKs

- [.NET](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/main/sdk/csharp/README.md): install, the request at each point, reading the result, authoring hooks and host declarations
- [Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/main/sdk/python/README.md)
- [TypeScript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/main/sdk/typescript/README.md)
- [Go](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/main/sdk/go/README.md)
- [Rust](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/responsibleai/agent-hooks/main/sdk/rust/README.md)
